verdict.rationale: skills.sh installs SKILL.md packages into agent skill directories. The linked Agent Skills spec says agents load each skill's name and description at startup to judge relevance, and a runtime probe shows every listed skill carries a full trigger description. The activation itself is performed by the host agent per the spec, not by the CLI. missing for 10: first-party guidance or tooling for engineering descriptions to trigger correctly, hands-on evidence that installed skills activate at the right moment, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, installed skills trigger automatically from task context, with descriptions engineered so the agent activates the right skill at the right moment

citations.quote: At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.
enumerated all 9 skills in a public repo — each with its name and full trigger description
